integrity: The parameter boundary is proved analytically. The least-total integer statement is a complete exact enumeration through combined total 46, using two independent Hamilton implementations and explicit symmetry reduction.
scientific_limitations: The exact integer census is for three states, two seats, strict Hamilton remainder cutoffs, positive integer populations, and componentwise nondecreasing census changes. Combined population is the chosen size measure.
title: Smallest monotone-growth population paradox for Hamilton apportionment
